crossRefs.note: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.
after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;
I said to them, “We, after our ability, have redeemed our brothers the Jews that were sold to the nations; and would…
none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me.
Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
“I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible.”

translations.web: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand?’ or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors?’
translations.bsb: deliver me from the hand of the enemy; redeem me from the grasp of the ruthless’?
translations.kjv: Or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?
translations.asv: Or, Deliver me from the adversary's hand? Or, Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors?
